messages:
Jules: Quick note  spotted a churn in the structured-output examples during the docs audit. One of the migration examples still uses the positional array form and the site linter flags it. Can we fix and add a CI guard?

Rae: which file path? I can patch if it's small.

Jules: docs/migration/tool-calling.md links to examples/compact-call.json which contains ["summarize", {"text": "x"}]. We recommend the envelope object now to avoid ambiguity.

Omar: I can swap it to the envelope format and add a brief compatibility paragraph. Proposed example: {"invoke": {"tool": "summarize", "args": {"text": "x"}}, "meta": {"example": "compact-v2"}}

Jules: yep, use envelope and host the file under /docs/examples/structured/ so links are stable. Also add a tiny docs-runner test that loads the example and asserts parsed.invoke.tool == 'summarize'.

Rae: I'll do the docs edits and replace the external gist link with the repo path. When updating links please use the canonical docs URL so redirects and link-checker are happy.

lint-bot: ci/docs-link-checker found external gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/legacy-sample (403 intermittent)

Omar: adding a pytest in infra/docs-tests/test_examples.py that checks parse result. Keeping it minimal so it runs fast.

Zara: small SDK note: TS SDK strict-mode will error on arrays; Python normalizes legacy arrays. We should add two short snippets to the migration guide showing how to convert.

Jules: action list: 1) Omar: replace example JSON with envelope and add tests; 2) Rae: update migration doc and links; 3) Zara: provide snippets for TS/Python; 4) Omar: add CI assertion.

Rae: opened PR with doc + example update: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4477  includes replacement file and wording. Left a TODO to add SDK snippets once Zara confirms.

Omar: PR for infra tests opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/827  small test that loads file from docs repo.

Zara: confirming snippets now, will push a follow-up commit to the docs PR.

lint-bot: ci/docs-runner flagged trailing commas in JSON example (lint error).

Rae: fixed trailing commas, force-pushed.

Omar: infra tests passed locally, waiting on CI.

Rae: docs PR merged after small wording nit fixed. Changelog note added: "Prefer envelope objects for tool-calling; arrays are legacy and deprecated in v2 preview."

Jules: great, thanks. Omar please file a follow-up to add a golden eval for the example so we catch semantic regressions.

Omar: filed evals issue: https://github.com/redwood/evals/issues/142  linking back to this thread.

Zara: added SDK advisory link in the migration doc. Closing loop.

Jules: thanks all :tada:
